column1: # Cold resume (review R3-01): fresh copy, stored checkpoint at depth_h, new service: load (open + zero-tolerance seek) then play().

# status_after_load must be paused (a slow open is .preparing while it lasts, never .failed). Environment: device iPhone18,1, iOS Version 27.0.1 (Build 24A446), Debug build, output at 1 % volume (quiet test runs); at the start: device load averages 2.88 2.14 2.14 (1, 5, 15 min)
